The season began on 14 March 2015, and finished on 18 November 2015. [[ZESCO United F.C.|ZESCO United]] won the league on 67 points, four points ahead of runners-up [[Zanaco F.C.|Zanaco]], with [[ZESCO United F.C.|ZESCO United]] qualifying for the [[2016 CAF Champions
